protocol: R1 (single round, one attempt per task per condition); all 22 S tasks scored by packet-based LLM report judging (at this base S13/S14/S20 are report-judged too — no keyword judges); concurrency 2 throughout
execution_notes: No API quota interruption and no relaunch during the solving phase (per the solving session's report).
S15-noskill solver report is truncated at the model output-length limit (159 lines, ends mid code block); judged as-is (90/100) per the single-attempt protocol — not an API/quota truncation.
Judge verdicts are stored under judge/{noskill,skill}/ (per-arm subdirectories; filenames are arm-agnostic).
Judge model (glm-5.3-flash) differs from solver (glm-5.3) but is the same family; same-family correlation bias disclosed.
